description: This file defines an enumeration (enum) named CalendarSyncAction, representing different actions (create, update, delete) that can be performed during calendar synchronization in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: CalendarSyncAction
classes.description: Enum that represents actions during calendar sync: create, update, delete.

methods.name: CREATE
methods.description: Represents the action to create a new calendar entry.

methods.name: UPDATE
methods.description: Represents the action to update an existing calendar entry.

methods.name: DELETE
methods.description: Represents the action to delete a calendar entry.
